stem.text: What causes water to move from the root hair cells to the endodermis?

A.text: diffusion through cell walls, osmosis down a water potential gradient in the cytoplasm

B.text: diffusion through the symplast, osmosis and root pressure through the apoplast

C.text: osmosis from cell vacuole to cell vacuole, active transport into the endodermis

D.text: osmosis through the intercellular spaces, diffusion in cell walls and cytoplasm
